name: TexTEC: Exploring Textile Technology, Engineering and Chemistry
org: NC State Wilson College of Textiles
what_you_do: A two-day camp. You do hands-on projects in the textile college's labs. They cover tech, engineering and chemistry.
who_can_apply: High school students. Preference goes to rising juniors and seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 camps were June to July 2026. Deadline was early June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Visit the TexTEC program website to learn more (textiles.ncsu.edu/academics/k-12/textec-camp). The page does not list the steps to apply.
